name: twilight_thorn_host_fight_creeper_orbhold
description: VUH-2617 lead #302: twilight_thorn_host_fight_creeper plus rescueOrbHold (thorn_orbhold.py): while Thorn is in its orb volley (motion 202) and the downed partner lies 1250+ from Thorn, the rescuer waits within 1000 of Thorn instead of walking to the partner, then approaches when the volley ends (capped at 30 s per revive window). VUH-2617 lead #282: twilight_thorn_host_fight plus Creeper-first targeting on the host seat (thorn_creeper.py, creeper_policy.py). Kills a Creeper (317) within the engage radius before returning to Thorn; revive, logical downs, RC/Reversal, events, the existing low-HP heal/evasion and Thorn's dazed opening keep priority. Everything else is unchanged.

steps.note: Native pad combat begins immediately. Only297/298/299 may use Triangle during the owned camera event, with exact initial room scope and living/logical-down checks. The known first-hit menu0/event0 box still receives bounded Cross; unknown event RCs receive no Triangle.
